# /sw:mobile

Installed mobile app. flows: plays the key tasks with Maestro on an emulator or device. audit: reads the screen shown on Android (touch targets, controls without a name). check: reads in the project what blocks a store release.

Arguments: `$ARGUMENTS`. Talk to the user in the project's report language.

Run from the project root (the folder with `.quality/project.json`):

```bash
node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/sw.mjs" mobile $ARGUMENTS
```
